services.title: Brand identity & positioning
services.tagline: When customers cannot tell who you are, or why they should trust you, we build the identity and message that make the business look established before the first conversation.
services.fit: Organizations renewing identity with real stakes in trust and growth.
services.nonFit: Trend-only refreshes or work that requires deceptive claims.

services.title: Websites that convert honestly
services.tagline: When visitors cannot find you, or do not trust what they find, we design and build sites that clarify the offer, earn credibility, and turn attention into qualified inquiries.
services.fit: Teams ready to treat the website as a business system, not a brochure dump.
services.nonFit: Disposable campaign microsites with no stewardship plan.

services.title: Quality assurance (QA)
services.tagline: When a launch broke, or never got tested, we verify journeys across real devices, catch what blocks revenue, and document issues so the business can ship with confidence.
services.fit: Businesses that need reliability as much as design before or after go-live.
services.nonFit: Rush launches that forbid accessibility or quality gates.

services.title: Mobile Money API integration
services.tagline: When customers expect to pay with Orange Money or MTN Mobile Money, we integrate those rails into your site or product so checkout and collections match how people actually pay.
items: Payment and collection flows that fit the customer journey
Error handling, receipts, and operator-ready handoff notes
services.fit: Businesses serving customers who pay by Mobile Money in Liberia and the region.
services.nonFit: Projects without clear payment ownership, compliance readiness, or operator account access.

services.title: Workshops & capability building
services.tagline: When your team needs shared language on brand, digital experience, or content operations, we facilitate focused workshops that leave people clearer and able to act.
items: Digital experience and content ops sessions
Practical playbooks the team can keep using
services.fit: Teams that want decisions and skill transfer, not slide decks that gather dust.
services.nonFit: Spectacles with no decision rights or follow-through owner.

services.title: Operations behind the brand
services.tagline: When the public face is fine but the systems behind it are not, we connect booking, inventory, and internal tools so the business runs as smoothly online as it does in person.
items: Integration and automation that serve operators
services.fit: Teams that need digital operations to match customer-facing craft.
services.nonFit: Tool sprawl with no owner or outcome definition.

services.title: Ongoing care & stewardship
services.tagline: When the site or product needs a partner after launch, we stay on for maintenance, improvements, and craft stewardship so trust does not erode over time.
items: Prioritized improvements tied to business goals
services.fit: Organizations that want continuity instead of agency churn.
services.nonFit: One-off fire drills with no path to stewardship.

services.title: Essential digital presence
services.tagline: When you need to look professional and easy to find online—Google, WhatsApp, social—without building a full website yet.
items: WhatsApp Business setup that matches the brand
Core social profile cleanup and consistency
Simple monthly check-ins so presence does not go stale
services.fit: Small retail, salons, clinics, and solo services with customers but weak or incomplete online presence.
services.nonFit: Teams that need a full custom website build, daily heavy content production, or committee-only decisions with no reachable owner.

services.title: Standard digital presence
services.tagline: When you already have some presence but no consistency—and you want a ready monthly plan you can approve and run, not a full outsourcing takeover.
items: Everything in Essential, with deeper consistency across channels
Monthly content calendar you approve and post
Review and trust-signal guidance (how customers find and trust you)
Light guidance so informal marketing becomes a repeatable rhythm
services.fit: Growing SMEs, restaurants, and professional services that want structure without a full managed content team.
services.nonFit: Daily/heavy managed content (future Premium territory), or projects that should be a full website engagement instead.
